comment_purpose: Git Crafter's outcomes and goals for every repo in the org. The Metrics and goals page rates each goal from data/org.json, which tools/collect_org.mjs writes. The owner set the purpose and the outcome groups in chat on 2026-11-02: the highest-quality build and product, built as fast as possible, with as few tokens as possible.
comment_goal: metrics[0] is the rated metric; the rest show in its drill-down. A goal is met at goal, near between goal and near, missed past near (the banded rule of quality/score.mjs scoreMetric). near sits on the worse side of goal. goal_source says where the number comes from: a Quality template target (quality/targets/<file> <id>) carries its own source, and 'Git Crafter goal, no public benchmark' gives the reason where none exists, as the template's targets do. per_repo false marks an org-wide total, which no single repo is rated against.
comment_scope: Every metric id is one tools/collect_org.mjs reads from GitHub, or one the Quality template defines (quality/targets). Template ids are copied from the org's site repo's committed quality/data/local.json with the site's own goal (copied_from names it), so a copied goal matches the template plus the site's overrides. site.* ids are the site's own checks; its tab scores stay on its Quality page, which site_link points to. claude.*, blockers.* and simplicity.* read the site's sessions until Git Crafter's own run of the template is read (orchestrator, 2026-11-03).

outcomes.name: Build quality
outcomes.means: Code, tests, CI and the PR flow hold up
outcomes.ideal: Every change is small, merges into main daily, and passes automated builds and tests at its head. No open PR waits on a conflict.

goals.label: CI runs that pass
goals.goal_source: Git Crafter goal, no public benchmark, as quality/targets/tests.json tests.main_pass_rate (95, near 85): a red run on a PR branch is CI doing its job, so not every run passes
goals.measured: GitHub Actions, each org repo's last 20 completed runs

goals.label: Test runs that pass
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/tests.json tests.main_pass_rate: the test jobs pass nearly every time, so a red run means a real break; re-goaled 2026-11-04 from 100, near 99, whose source (the site's code.test_pass_rate) is gone
goals.measured: GitHub Actions workflows named for tests, each org repo's last 20 runs of them

goals.label: PRs green when merged
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/github.json pull_requests.green_at_head: GitHub docs, About protected branches, require status checks before merging; every check passes at the merged head
goals.measured: Merged PRs' head commit checks, each org repo's last 20 merges

goals.label: Open PRs with conflicts
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/github.json pull_requests.conflicting: no waiting change needs a rebase
goals.measured: Open PRs' mergeable state, every org repo, at the read

goals.label: Private references in Git Crafter
goals.goal_source: the owner, 2026-11-03: Git Crafter goes open source with the org's settings kept apart, so none stay in template files; near band: Git Crafter goal, no public benchmark
goals.measured: Git Crafter tracked files outside config/ and data/, at the read: each name the org's config file (config/<org>.json) lists as private, and each /Users/<name> path

outcomes.name: Production quality
outcomes.means: What people use looks right, works, stays safe and stays up
outcomes.ideal: What people use meets WCAG 2.2 AA, answers fast, deploys without failing, and has no known vulnerable dependency left open.

goals.label: Text that fails contrast
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/design.json design.contrast_violations: WCAG 2.2 AA, SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum), as axe-core tests it
goals.measured: the site repo's Quality page data, committed

goals.label: Accessibility failures
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/usability.json usability.axe_violations: WCAG 2.2 AA as axe-core's default rules test it
goals.measured: the site repo's Quality page data, committed

goals.label: Open critical and high alerts
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/github.json security.dependabot_open: GitHub docs, About Dependabot alerts, each alert is a known vulnerability; none left open
goals.measured: Dependabot alerts, every org repo, at the read

goals.label: Deploys that succeed
goals.goal_source: Git Crafter goal, no public benchmark: a failed production build leaves its merge undeployed; DORA's elite change fail rate is 5% (quality/targets/deploy.json deploy.failure_rate_last10), and a build failure comes before any change reaches users
goals.measured: Production Workers Builds checks on default-branch commits, each org repo's last 20 deploys; staging builds left out

goals.label: Slowest recent Worker request
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/code.json code.worker_wall_max_ms: web.dev's good time to first byte, 0.8 seconds or less, poor above 1.8 seconds (web.dev/articles/ttfb)
goals.measured: the site repo's Quality page data, committed

outcomes.name: Speed
outcomes.means: Work goes from idea to live quickly
outcomes.ideal: A change goes from push to green in about ten minutes, merges within hours, and is live within minutes of its merge.

goals.label: PR open to merge, the latest
goals.goal_source: the site repo's quality/targets/github.json pull_requests.latest_merge_hours: goal set by the orchestrator, 2026-11-02, read as the latest merged PR at Git Crafter v2.0.0
goals.measured: The latest merged PR, every org repo

goals.label: All checks green to merge, median of the latest 10
goals.goal_source: Git Crafter goal, no public benchmark (the orchestrator, 2026-11-05): a PR merges within 30 minutes of all checks going green, since the merge waits only on the head-pinned review; near is 2 hours. Google's review-speed guide (google.github.io/eng-practices/review/reviewer/speed.html, read 2026-11-04) sets one business day as the slowest response, which this goal sits well inside
goals.measured: The latest 10 merged PRs, every org repo

goals.label: Push to green CI, the latest commit
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/ci.json ci.latest_flow: the ten-minute build (Kent Beck, Extreme Programming Explained, 2004; Martin Fowler, Continuous Integration, 2024-01-18)
goals.measured: GitHub Actions, the latest commit whose runs all passed, every org repo

goals.label: Hours since the 10th-latest merge
goals.goal_source: Git Crafter goal, no public benchmark: 10 merged PRs a day across the org, near 5, read as the hours from the 10th-latest merge to the read (orchestrator, 2026-11-04): 10 a day spans 24 hours, 5 a day 48
goals.measured: The 10 latest merged PRs across every org repo, to the read

goals.label: Merge to deployed, the latest
goals.goal_source: Git Crafter goal, no public benchmark: a Workers Build deploys a merge in minutes; DORA's elite lead time is under a day (quality/targets/deploy.json deploy.latest_lead_hours), of which this is the last step
goals.measured: The latest production Workers Build that succeeded, every org repo; staging builds left out

goals.label: Session start to PR, median
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/claude.json claude.hours_session_to_pr: a task scoped to land in one sitting
goals.measured: Claude transcripts, the site's committed local.json

outcomes.name: Claude tokens
outcomes.means: What Claude's tokens buy in Git Crafter and how fast
outcomes.ideal: Each merged PR costs few fresh tokens: context stays lean, most input is read from cache, and subagents return short summaries.

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents

goals.label: Tokens per merged PR
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/claude.json claude.tokens_per_merged_pr: the tokens billed at full or write price, about a short session's worth per PR
goals.measured: Claude transcripts, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Rework tokens on the latest merged PR
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/tokens.json tokens.latest_pr_rework_tokens: a tenth of claude.tokens_per_merged_pr's 2,000,000, near a quarter
goals.measured: Git Crafter's own row of the site Tokens tab's split by repo: the newest merged PR linked from a Git Crafter session; site committed local.json

goals.label: Tokens on PRs closed unmerged
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/tokens.json tokens.waste_share: a PR closed unmerged throws its session's work away, so its tokens bought nothing
goals.measured: Git Crafter's own row of the site Tokens tab's split by repo: the last 20 finished PRs linked from Git Crafter sessions; site committed local.json

goals.label: Review-fix rounds per merged PR
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/tokens.json tokens.review_fix_rounds_per_pr: one confirming review round plus at most half a round that finds something per PR
goals.measured: Git Crafter's own row of the site Tokens tab's split by repo; site committed local.json

goals.label: Tokens the latest subagent returned
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/tokens.json tokens.latest_subagent_return_tokens: Anthropic, Effective context engineering for AI agents (2025-09-29), a subagent returns a distilled summary of often 1,000 to 2,000 tokens
goals.measured: Git Crafter's own row of the site Tokens tab's split by repo: the newest subagent to finish in a Git Crafter session; site committed local.json

goals.label: Input served from cache
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/claude.json claude.cache_read_share: a cache read is priced at a small fraction of fresh input, so a cache miss reprices a whole context
goals.measured: Claude transcripts, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Subagent share of cost
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/claude.json claude.subagent_cost_share: at most half the spend in subagents, priced, so routing work to a cheaper model reads as cheaper
goals.measured: Claude transcripts, the site's committed local.json

outcomes.name: Blockers
outcomes.means: Each restriction on Claude catches more than it costs in time and tokens
outcomes.ideal: Each hook, guard and check blocks only what it must, rarely fires falsely, and costs seconds and few tokens when it does.

sources.title: Flaky Tests at Google and How We Mitigate Them

goals.label: Blockers that cost more than they help
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/blockers.json blockers.costly: a restriction whose false alarms are half its fires or more costs more than it catches
goals.measured: The quality template's blockers collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Guard blocks that were false alarms
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/blockers.json blockers.guard_false_alarm_share: a guard that blocks commands which then run in another form slows work without stopping anything
goals.measured: The quality template's blockers collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Guard blocks per 100 tool calls
goals.goal_source: code-os config/quality/targets/blockers.json blockers.guard_blocks_per_100_calls: template goal, no public benchmark: one block in 2,000 tool calls; a guard that fires often is in the way more than it protects. The Guard map step rates the same id from Git Crafter's own run
goals.measured: The quality template's blockers collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Checks that failed, then passed on the same commit
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/ci.json ci.flaky_reruns: below the 1.5% of test runs Google reported flaky (Google Testing Blog, Flaky Tests at Google and How We Mitigate Them, 2016)
goals.measured: The quality template's ci collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Seconds the latest block cost
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/blockers.json blockers.latest_block_seconds: a blocked call answered and replaced in well under a minute
goals.measured: The quality template's blockers collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Tokens the latest block cost
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/blockers.json blockers.latest_block_tokens: less than two model calls at the Claude tab's context goal of 150,000 tokens
goals.measured: The quality template's blockers collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Reviewer tokens per merged PR
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/blockers.json blockers.review_tokens_per_pr: half the Claude tab's goal of 2,000,000 tokens per merged PR
goals.measured: The quality template's blockers collector, the site's committed local.json

outcomes.name: Simplicity
outcomes.means: The repos and the Claude system stay small, current and said once
outcomes.ideal: Always-loaded instructions stay a few thousand tokens, say each rule once, and point only at files that exist.

goals.label: Always-loaded instruction tokens
goals.goal_source: code-os config/quality/targets/instructions.json claude.instruction_tokens: template goal, no public benchmark: the always-loaded files within a few thousand tokens, in line with the memory docs' target of under 200 lines per CLAUDE.md file (code.claude.com/docs/en/memory, read 2026-11-03); the MEMORY index is counted apart. Git Crafter's own run rates it (the site's goal was 4400, near 6600)
goals.measured: The quality template's instructions collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Memory index
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/instructions.json instructions.memory_index_tokens: a one-line-per-entry index, as the Claude Code memory docs ask
goals.measured: The quality template's instructions collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Rules said twice
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/simplicity.json simplicity.restated_rules: a rule said in two always-loaded files costs its tokens twice and drifts when one copy changes
goals.measured: The quality template's simplicity collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Broken references in rules and memory
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/simplicity.json simplicity.broken_refs: a reference to a file that is gone sends Claude looking for it
goals.measured: The quality template's simplicity collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Copies that differ from their source
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/simplicity.json simplicity.copy_drift: an installed copy that differs from its source runs rules nobody reviewed
goals.measured: The quality template's simplicity collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Figures with no recent read date
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/simplicity.json simplicity.undated_figures: a figure is attributed or labeled a goal (rules/writing-and-gates.md); one with no read date cannot be checked
goals.measured: The quality template's simplicity collector, the site's committed local.json

goals.label: Memory notes naming what is gone
goals.goal_source: quality/targets/simplicity.json simplicity.memory_stale_refs: a memory note naming a path or flag that is gone teaches a session something false
goals.measured: The quality template's simplicity collector, the site's committed local.json
